announcements.headline: EQS-News: E.ON reaffirms 2026 guidance and continues to invest in Europe’s energy infrastructure
announcements.insight: Reaffirming guidance provides stability for a utility sector currently navigating volatile wholesale prices and regulatory shifts, while continued infrastructure investment signals long-term commitment to Europe's energy transition amidst high capital expenditure cycles.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: E.ON successfully completes acquisition of OVO in the UK
announcements.insight: This acquisition marks E.ON's definitive entry into the UK residential energy market, leveraging OVO's established brand and customer base to drive growth in a highly competitive sector. It signals a strategic pivot towards consumer-facing retail operations, aligning with broader European utility trends of vertical integration to capture downstream margins.
